topic: Some people believe all university students should study science. To what extent do you agree?

turns.text: 请只根据我这次对科学课程的想法来帮我。
我是不是一直有某个固定的语言弱点？

seed.draft: I disagree with making science compulsory. Students should be able to choose subjects they enjoy.
